items.question: Is this a dark banking design?
items.answer: No. The foundation is intentionally light, with white backgrounds, gray sections, and yellow brand accents.

items.question: Can the homepage be extended later?
items.answer: Yes. The layout is structured so more banking sections and pages can be added without reworking the visual system.

items.question: Does the design support multiple languages?
items.answer: Yes. Uzbek, English, and Russian content stays in dedicated translation files.
